items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: I think Stepen Fetchit has a lot to do with Mohammed's fighting.

ctx.x: And you know, on the shows, all these people loved to gamble. Stepen Fetchit used to have a dressing room, have all kinds of biscuits for the boys, and they would come there to get him. And he would rob them every week. I was on the show with him for about 31 weeks and he robbed them 31 weeks. And I said, "Stepen" he said, "What, do you say, Jack. If they want it, And so I give them the pleasure of trying. (Inaudible)."

I think Stepen Fetchit has a lot to do with Mohammed's fighting. Because I can see things in what Stepen Fetchit's (logically) and everything, because that have a lot to do with Elijah and all that. Did you know that?
